title: Classic Paccheri alla Pugliese
description: A traditional Italian recipe from Puglia featuring paccheri pasta, yellow tomatoes, and molten mozzarella.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook paccheri pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add chopped yellow cherry tomatoes and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Add cooked paccheri pasta to the skillet with tomatoes.
Top with molten mozzarella cheese and cook until melted.
Garnish with chopped fresh basil (if using).
